title: Hybrid read: one timeline plus a few big accounts, merged by time
caption: A reader follows only a handful of huge accounts, so the read-time merge costs a few extra lookups, not 300.

messages.label: GET timeline:bob
messages.note: Everything pushed by normal authors is already here, newest first.

messages.label: recent posts of 3 big accounts
messages.note: Bob follows 3 accounts above the threshold. Their posts were never fanned out.

messages.label: batch GET 20 bodies
messages.note: Timelines hold ids, so an edit or delete needs no fan-out, only a filter here.

scenarios.name: Big-account cache down
scenarios.summary: The cache of big accounts' posts is unreachable. Fall back to reading those authors' posts from the store: slower, still correct, and only for a few authors.

messages.label: recent posts of 3 big accounts
messages.note: The cache node is down: the request times out after a short deadline.

messages.label: recent posts of those 3 authors
messages.note: Fallback: query the posts store directly. A few extra ms for this reader.

messages.label: page of 20
messages.note: Same feed. Keep the deadline short so a dead cache costs little.

scenarios.name: Risk: one key, every read
scenarios.summary: The biggest accounts' recent posts are read on nearly every feed open, all from one cache key on one node. Replicate those keys and cache them locally in the feed service.

messages.label: recent posts of the top account
messages.note: Almost every reader follows a few of the same giant accounts.

messages.label: timeout
messages.note: One node owns that key and takes all 23 000 reads/s. It saturates while the others idle.

messages.label: local copy, refresh 1 s
messages.note: Fix: copy the key to several replicas and read any one, plus a short-lived in-process cache.

scenarios.name: Reader follows many giants
scenarios.summary: The merge is cheap because readers follow only a few big accounts. A reader following hundreds of them is back to pull's cost: cap or precompute for them.

messages.label: GET timeline:fan
messages.note: This user follows 400 accounts above the threshold.

messages.label: recent posts of 400 big accounts
messages.note: 400 lookups plus a merge: the cost the hybrid was meant to avoid.

messages.label: merge 400 lists
messages.note: Slow for this reader, and they're the heaviest users.

messages.label: page of 20 (slow)
messages.note: Mitigation: only the most recently active giants per read, or cache this reader's merged result for a short time.
